_comment: The Android TV section of the site, switched off.
playLive: false until Google Play shows the Nostalgex listing (Chad confirms by opening the
public Play page). The Android beta and the review are not a reason to flip it: nothing can
be joined yet and the site makes no promise about it. While it is false the page is not built,
not linked, not in the sitemap and not in llms.txt, and `npm test` (android:check) fails if any
playUrl: null until then. It is the public Play listing link, nothing else. No beta or join link.
1. Marketing fills every TODO(marketing) in content/android/android.html.
2. Move that file to android.html at the repo root, set its robots meta to index, follow, and
3. vite.config.js: add 'android' to the site inputs. vercel.json: add the /android rewrite.
4. Add Android TV after Roku in every footer (grep 'href="/roku">Roku')
and in scripts/site-chrome.mjs. Add the home tile and hero button if marketing wants them.
5. public/sitemap.xml and public/llms.txt: one line each. README: an Android TV column in the table
and a heading with the live version, once readme-versions-check has a rule for it.
6. Set playLive true and playUrl, then update scripts/android-section-check.mjs (it flips from
'nothing public' to 'page, link and sitemap line all present').
No contributor names anywhere on the site (Chad, 2026-11-11). Credit is GitHub and Discord only.
